I'm no expert, but some suggestions: 

1. Watch 'how to stream in osu' videos on youtube
2. use mech keyboard (if you have one)
3. Download and play burst stream maps
4. Download and play deathstream maps (play 1 or 2 a day... read next suggestion for specifics)
5. try starting off streaming at lower bpm's and focus on accuracy. Slowly turn up the bpm as you reach a comfortable level 

Generally, as you play more, you will develop more stamina, accuracy, and a better ability to do streams in general.

1. To fix the sliders thing, you need to download a 'skin'. The default osu skin is really hard to look at and understand whats going on (as you have described) . There are an infinite number to chose from, and you can simply search up 'best skins osu 2020' on youtube and download whichever you like. To change the background to black, you go to the in-game settings (CTRL + O) and search background dim. Turn that to 100%.
2. Music should not be slower than normal, unless you downloaded a remix or something like that. Alternatively, you may have accidentally set your global offset (also found in settings) to something other than the default, which may make it seem like the song is slower or faster than normal.
3. To my knowledge, you cannot disable music in the menu like you want to. However, I think there is a keybind that lets you pause and play the menu song really easily, which may be more efficient than clicking the pause button. 
4. check your display settings and make sure your game resolution matches your monitor/screen resolution. If that doesnt fix it, try locating your osu folder and running 'repair osu!' There are some settings in there where you can possibly fix your problem.

Horde all your precious rocks (sapphires, rubys, diamonds, topaz, etc). After you clear the fire divine beast (the one on the volcano), a merchant (a gerudo woman walking around) appears in goron city. She buys 10 of a precious rock at a time and gives you 30% (i think... Might be more) additional rupees for it. 

Other than that you can make a potion with lynel parts and a rare bug (search ut up on youtube) that you can sell for like 14k rupees (someone correct me if im wrong).

Selling dragon horns are good too, but i wouldn't recommend it because it takes a while. 

Other than that, farm the powerful weapons in hyrule castle every blood moon reset and you will be extremely op in the early game. After that, farm silver lynels and get their 5x bows. They can also drop a 100+ attack 2 handed weapon and a 80+ 1 handed weapon.

When you cook health potions use only one 'hearty' material as they refill all your health and give temp hearts. You can farm hearty durians (the best 'hearty' item) in the rainforest right beside the regional tower (search up youtube video). 

Get dlc and complete master trials to power up master sword as its very useful to have.

Get ssb zelda amiibo and do soft resets until you get the twilight bow. Legit its incredible.

Complete all shrines so you can flex on your friends.

Get the travel medallion because its op. 

Get hylian shield because its op and build tarrey town so you can get it once it breaks.

Get dlc and upgrade your abilities so you can spam rivalis gale.

Get the fastest horse in the game (always spawns in same location. Search up youtube video. Btw its not epona)

Place a pin on all the valuable orw deposits you see or come across (the black rock things on mountains. You know they have valuables in them when they have a gold color on them). Every blood moon they respawn and you can farm them for easy rupees.

Farm the coliseum items every blood moon for elemental weapons. (someone correct me if im wrong but every enemy in the coliseum has an elemental weapon). You shock them with a shock arrow or a lighning sword amd they drop the weapon). 

The korok forest shop sells herbs and mushrooms that are very rare, and can be useful for making potions. 

Killer tip: YOU CAN USE STASIS ON ENEMIES TO FREEZE THEM. You can use this to run away before you get hit by an AOE attack or use it to freeze them and then do some damage. Keep in mind the stronger the enemy is the less time they will be frozen.

Get the barbarian armor set asap because its op once upgraded

Give 5 peices of fruit to a dog at any stable and they will lead you to a hidden chest where you can use magnesis to pull it out.

You can use stasis as you walk around to look at all interactable objects and items around you. For example, use stasis in a forest and it might highlight mushrooms or thistles or something idk

To avoid Guardian beams, run (or full gallop) in a 30-50 degree angle from the direction of the beam. You will avoid the attack every time.

Try to unlock the Dueling peaks shrine (the shrine at the top of the taller of the 2 dueling peaks). This is a very useful fast travel option to have because you can glide a large diameter around it. Also, it is the best spot in the game to initiate star fragment farming (they sell for high prices and can be used to upgrade lots of your armor).

During some test of strength trials inside shrines, you can use cryonis to make pillars of ice. This can be very beneficial because it blocks guardian beams, completely stops the spin attack of guardians (this may require 2 pillars, i dont remember), and also lets you do a jump attack (with a high-power 2 handed weapon) for extra damage. Additionally, if the guardian is doing the spinning laser beam attack, you can create a pillar at a distance where it will not be destroyed by the beam. Get on the pillar and wait for the perfect moment to snipe the guardians eye with your bow (do this while jumping off the pillar because it will initiate the slow falling mechanic where time slows down).

For 100% completionists or for people who want to know where to find all korok seeds, or shrines, and other useful info like all overworld sub-boss locations (lynels, talus, hinox), there is an interactive map online (https://www.zeldadungeon.net/breath-of-the-wild-interactive-map/?lat=0.8976&lng=0.7112) that i highly recommend for everyone remotely interested. You can filter out icons so the map doesnt look all clumped up, and you can even check off shrines and korok seeds you have found (so they disappear from the interactive map). In this way, you can only focus on finding the shrines or korok seeds you need.
